prerequisites: Ability to read and understand documentation written in English.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to design, develop, manage and evaluate certification and security assurance mechanisms in the treatment and access to information in a local or distributed processing system.
Define and implement information security management systems
Audit and certify information security management systems

syllabus_topics: Regulations and standards applicable to security management and governance
Implementation of an ISMS: security procedures
Review and improvement of an ISMS
assessment_rules: For the ordinary and extraordinary calls, the final grade is calculated as 0.4 * Theoretical Exam + 0.6 * Group Work. To pass the course, each part (Theoretical Exam and Group Work) must be passed with a minimum grade of 5 out of 10. If the group work is approved in the ordinary call, the grade is kept for the extraordinary call; otherwise, a new group work must be submitted and reviewed.
